name: Eddy Corado
headline: SVP Operations | Retail | Wholesale | Supply Chain | Production | Technology | Digital Strategy | DTC

experiences.description:
Work with CEO to develop and direct execution of $1.5M annual operating budget and 30 staff across 5 flagship offices and factories for $2.5B public company (NASDAQ: CTRC, leading lifestyle brands collective bringing together creative minds to design, manufacture and manage men’s and women’s apparel and accessories and kidswear). Oversee distribution across traditional retail and eCommerce channels in North America and international markets. Lead process evaluation and develop strategies / implementation plans to improve and standardize all aspects of enterprise supply chain (SCM). Oversee key segments of business – Business Solutions & Training (BST), Design Ops, Design, Product Development (PD). Lead Chamber of Commerce Engagement to drive new tax / business incentives. 

* Led successful end-to-end organizational restructure as part of major new company acquisitions – BCBGMaxazria, Herve Leger, Bebe – which increased overall efficiencies by approx. 25% 
* Headed executive alignment to bring senior stakeholders from conflict into consensus 
* Directed complex and sensitive operation separations and cloning activities during major ($4B) company separation initiative (spinoff)
* Drove successful (on time, on budget) implementation of complex systems and processes including PLM, 3D, and WIP – on track to repay 100% of investment in less than a year
* Managed software contract renegotiations which have substantially reduced licensing costs.  
* Slashed operating costs by 30% by leading major office relocations and lease renegotiations

experiences.companyName: Global Brands Group (Member of Fung Group)
experiences.description:
Developed and oversaw execution of $2.5M annual operating budget and 100 staff across 8 domestic and overseas offices for $4B public company (HKEX: 0787.HK, world leader in branded fashion Apparel, Accessories and Footwear). Evaluated potential new acquisitions. Revamped budget management with more effective and proactive P&L analysis.

* Played key role in annual revenue growth from $3B to $4B in 4 years with strategic acquisitions and integrations Joe’s Jeans, Buffalo Jeans, Frye, Jimlar, Jones NY, Aquatalia, Spyder, Tahari
* As above, provided strategic direction of end-to-end organizational restructure
* Drove transition of global supply chain from paper to digital SCM, which further improved margins while reducing order delays by almost 4 weeks
* Headed integration of newly acquired acquisitions into current divisional structures – both staff teambuilding and executive coaching to reach alignment across both cultures 
* Drove successful implementation of PLM across new acquired divisions, and of 3D across Apparel, Footwear, Jewelry and Accessories categories
